messages.en:
I can't wait to talk to
you again!
messages.et:
Ootan juba, et saaksin
sinuga jälle rääkida!

messages.en:
Let me know when you're
in town next, OK?
messages.et:
Anna teada, kui oled
järgmine kord linnas, eks?

messages.en:
I'll be waiting for your
next visit!

Next time you visit, let's
have {04 14 00}!

I waited for you to visit
us today, but...
messages.et:
Ootasin täna, et sa
tuleksid, aga...

messages.en:
For your next visit, I'll
make {04 13 00}!

Come visit again anytime!
We'll be waiting!
messages.et:
Tule jälle külla, millal
tahad! Me ootame!

messages.en:
Next time I want to come
visit you!
messages.et:
Järgmine kord tahan mina
sulle külla tulla!

messages.en:
You should come visit us
again. It'd be so fun!
messages.et:
Sa peaksid meile jälle
külla tulema. Oleks tore!

messages.en:
I forgot to give you this,
so I'm sending it now.
messages.et:
Unustasin selle sulle anda,
nii et saadan nüüd.

messages.en:
I'm not above bribing you
to come visit again!
messages.et:
Ma pole kõrgem sinu
külla meelitamisest!

messages.en:
I don't know if you'll like
this, but please take it.
messages.et:
Ma ei tea, kas see sulle
meeldib, aga palun võta.

messages.en:
You left this, remember?
Here it is.
messages.et:
Sa jätsid selle maha,
mäletad? Siin see on.

messages.en:
I remembered that I had
something to give you.
messages.et:
Mulle meenus, et mul on
sulle midagi anda.

messages.en:
I thought you'd like this.
Please take it.
messages.et:
Arvasin, et see meeldib
sulle. Palun võta.
